items.claim: Gillian Robertson is on a five-fight win streak, particularly since moving down to strawweight.
items.quote: Gillian Robertson, who is five and 0 in her last five, makes sense. She's been on a run, especially since moving down to strawweight.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson has forward pressure and a decent one-two striking combination.
items.quote: the forward pressure and she's got a decent one-two for Robertson is there.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is durable and can take a punch.
items.quote: She's durable as well. She can take a punch

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is better at securing takedowns and is persistent in getting them on her terms.
items.quote: She's the um probably the better at getting the takedowns. She's a solid grappler overall, but she has a decent takedown and she is persistent in getting the takedown

items.claim: Gillian Robertson constantly attacks with armbars and rear naked chokes with slick transitions and heavy ground and pound.
items.quote: She does constantly attack with the armbars and the rear naked chokes. She'll chain them together... She's got slick transitions on the mat, and she is very willing to go with the heavy heavy ground and pound

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern's striking improvement is inconsistent from fight to fight.
items.quote: In fact, sometimes she'll show improvement, but it's not consistent.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has a decent step-in random overhand that works for her.
items.quote: She does have a decent step-in overhand... It's very strange, but it works, right? It works for her.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern's striking defense is not good at all.
items.quote: striking defense isn't good at all. Not at all.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is tough and has good durability, never wilting in fights.
items.quote: her durability is there. She's tough. You're never going to see Mackenzie Dern just kind of like wilt.
